findings: New appended Scope::SessionIoPrepared explicitly permits Runtime-managed PreparedJobs while independent proof still seals new external admission and drains unmanaged raw/deferred/foreign work. Existing AcceptOnly/SessionIo requirements/defaults and enum values preserved.

Runtime rejects prepared scope without finite prepared-stop budget and verifies exact PreparedJobSourceDrain/selected PreparedJobs before Stop.bind(...,managed). Stop refuses new scope without explicit managed binding; no controller raw Parent access is added.

Stop.session_io_pending is original-worker/Parent-only and checks accepted stop state, pending loans, active IO packet bindings and unacknowledged stop routes. Inert accept aliases require exact OwnedAcceptMemory identity. close_worker independently checks active bindings as well as loans for new scope.

Runtime stop gate now pumps/queries selected IO alongside source jobs. Progress rechecked after ready receipt, after Stop.after releases each IO route, and after swallowed private stop wakes. Late response loans are cancelled/observed or queued Posted work discarded before stop resumes. Generic dispatcher work transfer and original worker initialize/finish are unchanged.

Controller active-post metadata is intentionally not used as an in-Parent drain predicate: consuming its only wake before post returns could otherwise strand the loop. Existing close_worker waits for posts_done outside Parent before releasing Stop backing.

Three source scenarios: session-drain expects one real native child body/receipt plus scripted accept/receive/send/Posted completion drain then closed Graph/Profile/NativeJobs/Stop and actual original/child join before controller backing release; cancel denial201 and missing scripted IO202 retain session/IO/control without worker finish or port close.

Fixture uses own actual IOCP and native thread/Domain paths as unexecuted source expectations, but sockets/CancelIoEx results are synthetic. Scripted995 is not observed kernel cancellation; constant external proof is an explicit private-fixture assumption. Normal independent physical proof joins still control child scheduling.
